source.name: SportingKC.com: 'Sporting Kansas City and Saint Luke’s team up for new community-affiliated partnership'
source.quote: The historic Saint Luke’s logo will be proudly worn as a patch on the right sleeve of Sporting KC’s primary and secondary jerseys on gamedays
source.note: Multi-year partnership announced 12 December 2025 (the club page renders no date; the Kansas City Star dated the announcement Friday, December 12, 2025), effective from the 2026 MLS season. The Kansas City Star reports the arrangement 'runs through 2031, according to the Kansas City Business Journal' (https://www.kansascity.com/sports/soccer/sporting-kc/article313663940.html, opened via the Wayback Machine capture of 13 Dec 2025), so 'to' is 2031.

note: Right-sleeve patch plus training-gear fronts; official health care provider. Value not disclosed.
